msg: Hey, I'm a certified diver and I'd love to do a night dive. Is that possible? How much?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A night dive in the Rosario Islands is a fantastic experience! Yes, it’s possible with the **3-dive package**: two daytime dives and one night dive.

You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; lodging isn’t included.

The online price includes the 10% website-booking discount.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: From Cartagena. I'm Canadian, Advanced Open Water, last dive 6 months ago. Just me, next Tuesday.
reply:
Perfect! The **3-dive package** includes two daytime dives and one night dive, with a certified PADI professional. Your Advanced Open Water certification and recent dive history fit the certified-diver plan.

It’s a one-day activity, but you’ll need to stay overnight on the islands because the night dive doesn’t return to Cartagena the same day. The boat transfer from Cartagena and lunch are included; accommodation and transport to the dock are not.

The meeting point is **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.** I’m sharing the plan details below. Would you like help with anything else about the trip?

🤿 *3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive)*
💰 *287 USD* per person
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 3 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch on day 1 and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

ℹ️ More information here:
https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/

👉 To book this, let me know and I'll connect you with an advisor who arranges the details with you.
